issue.body:
### Neovim version (nvim -v)

v.0.8.0-dev-1079-gf623e160-dirty

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

No

### Operating system/version

macOS 12.5.1

### Terminal name/version

wezterm  20220911-072154

### $TERM environment variable

wezterm

### Installation

homebrew 

### How to reproduce the issue

- Clone `vim-fugitive` to `$HOME/.local/share/nvim/site/pack/packer/start`
- Start with minimal nvim

```init.lua
vim.opt["cmdheight"] = 0
```

- Make some commit and **push to remote** using shortcuts inside `GStatus`
- Make another one and push again will result in crash (possibly take more than 2nd times to program crashed)

**Note** local commit is working OK, make sure pushing commit to remote to reproduce the issues

### Expected behavior

No crash
If `vim.opt['cmdheight'] = 1`, `vim-fugitive` working as expected without crashes.

### Actual behavior

Nvim crashed very often after 2nd, 3rd pushes or more.

body:
I don't reproduce the problem.

> v0.8.0-dev-1070-g9b4cab012

It seems old.  Please use HEAD.  The HEAD is `NVIM v0.8.0-dev-2538-g907fc8ac3`.

v0.8.0-dev-1070-g9b4cab012 was HEAD at time of reporting, nothing relevant has changed since then.
